clue.text: Moving restlessly from front of boat with fish

parts.note: the prow is the forward part of a boat's hull
the ling is a long-bodied sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A fish swims about restlessly in front of a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: Prowling means roaming about stealthily or restlessly, as a hunting animal does.

clue.text: Damned well after illness, containing second

indicators.note: containing says the first piece holds the next one within it

parts.note: someone well again after being ill has been cured

explanation.surface: A grumble that being well again after an illness still leaves one stuck for a second.
explanation.definitionFit: Damned and cursed are synonyms, both meaning condemned or blighted by a curse.

clue.text: Before one's mass, hear about European form of religious instruction

indicators.note: Before puts the hearing piece ahead of the one's-mass pieces in the answer
about says the first piece goes around the European abbreviation

parts.note: to catch a remark is to hear it
one's is read as one is, I plus IS
M is the physics symbol for mass

explanation.surface: Before Mass, someone hears about a European kind of religious teaching.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Before' places CATECH (CATCH around E) ahead of I, S and M, though the clue mentions them first.
explanation.definitionFit: A catechism is a summary of Christian doctrine taught through question and answer.

clue.text: Reprimanded about learner, part of issue that needs raising

definitions.text: part of issue that needs raising

indicators.note: about says the scolding word goes round the learner's letter

parts.note: chid is an old past tense of chide, to scold or reprimand
L stands for learner, as on a learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A learner driver is scolded about some problem that needs bringing up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Issue' looks like a matter for discussion, but it means offspring, and 'raising' means bringing up a youngster.
explanation.definitionFit: Issue means offspring, and a youngster is one of those offspring who must be brought up.

clue.text: Boundaries around English or French city

indicators.note: around says the edges go about the English letter

parts.note: rims are edges or borders

explanation.surface: Borders drawn around an English or a French city.
explanation.definitionFit: Reims is a city in north-east France, famous for champagne and its cathedral.

clue.text: Put away amount of money, as stated, for dance

indicators.note: as stated says the words are said out loud to get the answer's spelling

parts.note: put away means ate, as of food, and an amount of money is a sum

explanation.surface: Someone tucks a sum of money away and then goes off dancing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put away' suggests saving money, but it means eaten.
explanation.definitionFit: An eightsome reel is a Scottish country dance for eight people.

clue.text: Devour gin, led astray — did consume too much

indicators.note: astray says these letters wander from their order into a new one

explanation.surface: Someone devours gin, is led astray, and has had far too much.
explanation.definitionFit: To overindulge is to eat or drink to excess, so this past tense means consumed too much.

clue.text: For example, realists work hard in quietly greeting defeated team

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
hi is a greeting

indicators.note: in puts the work and hard letters inside the defeated team

parts.note: the defeated team are the losers
OP is short for opus, a musical work
H is the pencil-grading abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: Realists work hard, quietly greeting a beaten team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Realists' are those holding the philosophical position of realism.
explanation.definitionFit: Realists hold a school of thought about reality, so they are one example of thinkers in this field.

clue.text: Some president, I calculate, is lacking any distinction

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A president's reckoning that something has no distinction at all.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is followed by 'is' as a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that are exactly alike lack any distinguishing difference between them.

clue.text: Possibly brilliant change of direction

parts.note: a brilliant is a cut gem, and a turn from south to north-east is written ...

explanation.surface: A brilliant possibility hinted at by a turn in a new direction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brilliant' is the noun, a many-faceted cut diamond; the answer split as S TO NE is a change of compass direction.
explanation.definitionFit: A brilliant is a cut gem, so it is one example of a precious gem.

clue.text: Persistently pester last chap in undistinguished trio

definitions.meaning: to harass or nag someone repeatedly
Tom, Dick and ... is the stock phrase for ordinary people at large

explanation.surface: Someone nags the last of three nobodies.
explanation.definitionFit: Harry means to harass, and is the third name in the phrase Tom, Dick and Harry.

clue.text: After short spell, keyboard player missing second drummer

indicators.note: After puts the keyboard player's letters after the shortened spell
short says the period word loses its final letter

parts.note: a spell is a period of time

indicators.note: missing second says the keyboard player loses the letter in second place

parts.note: a pianist plays the keyboard

explanation.surface: After a brief stint, a pianist is gone for a moment and a drummer appears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'second' is not S here: it means the player's second letter, the I, is dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: A timpanist plays the kettledrums in an orchestra, so is a kind of drummer.

clue.text: Craftsperson who ultimately puts black away?

definitions.meaning: a maker of ceramics at a wheel
in snooker the black ball is usually sunk last, by someone sinking balls into pockets

explanation.surface: A craftsperson who, in the end, clears away the dark stuff.
explanation.walkthrough: In snooker, a British cue game, the black is normally the last ball pocketed.
explanation.definitionFit: A potter makes pots, and in snooker a potter sinks balls into the pockets.

clue.text: Wild animals in conflict with outfit protecting hospital

parts.note: war is armed conflict

indicators.note: protecting says the clothes surround the hospital letter

parts.note: togs are clothes, an outfit
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: Wild animals caught up in a war, with an outfit protecting a hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: Warthogs are wild African pigs with tusks and facial warts.

clue.text: Choose an ancient character said to be old-fashioned rogue

indicators.note: said to be says the phrase is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: choose means pick, an is A, and a rune is a character of an ancient alphabet

explanation.surface: Picking an old-fashioned character who turns out to be a rascal.
explanation.definitionFit: Picaroon is an archaic word for a rogue, pirate or adventurer.

clue.text: Frequently ring paper initially, then another

parts.note: O is ring-shaped
FT is the Financial Times newspaper
The Times is another newspaper, the one this crossword appears in

explanation.surface: Ringing the paper first, and then another one, over and over.
explanation.definitionFit: Ofttimes is an archaic word for often or many times.

clue.text: The better he is, the less likely people will pick his work

definitions.text: The better he is, the less likely people will pick his work

parts.words: The better he is, the less likely people will pick his work
parts.note: picking a lock is the way to open it without a key, so a well-made one resists picking

explanation.surface: A craftsman whose excellence makes people less likely to choose what he makes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pick' suggests choosing, but it means opening a lock without its key.
explanation.definitionFit: A tradesman who makes and fits locks wants them to resist picking.

clue.text: Quality of wine the writer's included — that's what we hear

indicators.note: included says the writer's letter is put inside the wine word

parts.note: the nose of a wine is its aroma or bouquet
the writer is I, from the setter's point of view

explanation.surface: A wine writer includes a quality they can hear in the wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Noise is sound, especially unwanted sound, which is what we hear.

clue.text: Like marginally unfinished book, yet to be censored

definitions.meaning: a book whose page edges have not been trimmed
not yet edited or cut down by a censor

explanation.surface: A book unfinished at the margins, not yet passed by the censor.
explanation.definitionFit: Untrimmed page edges and unabridged text are both described by the same word.

clue.text: Would-be partner having diamonds, perhaps, and gold

parts.note: diamonds is one example of a suit of cards
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A would-be partner comes bearing diamonds and gold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'diamonds' suggests an engagement ring, but it is a card suit.
explanation.definitionFit: A suitor is a man seeking to marry or court someone.

clue.text: Shake hand, finally, of less conventional type

indicators.note: finally says to take only the closing letter of the word hand

parts.note: odder means stranger, less conventional

explanation.surface: Shaking hands, finally, with someone rather unconventional.
explanation.definitionFit: To dodder is to tremble or totter unsteadily, as with age.

clue.text: Runs, full of self-satisfaction, on reconstructed legs

parts.note: smug means pleased with oneself

indicators.note: reconstructed says the letters of legs are rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: A smug runner on newly rebuilt legs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Runs' looks like jogging, but it means sneaks contraband, as in gun-running.
explanation.definitionFit: To run goods is to carry them illegally across a border, as a contraband trader does.

clue.text: Fastidious as daughter about cutting flower

indicators.note: cutting says the about letters slice into the flower word

parts.note: the flower of a group is its finest part, its elite
CA is circa, about

explanation.surface: A daughter fussy about cutting flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' is not a bloom or a river here but the best of a group.
explanation.definitionFit: Delicate can mean fastidious or sensitive in taste, easily offended by coarseness.

clue.text: Incidentally, it has an aptness as an anagram

indicators.note: as an anagram openly asks for the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A remark in passing on how apt a phrase is when its letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: En passant is French for in passing, used in English to mean by the way.

clue.text: Leader from Mexico I'm lodging in Oregon otherwise

indicators.note: lodging in says the IM letters stay inside the rearranged state name
otherwise says the state name is written another way

parts.note: I'm gives the letters IM

explanation.surface: A Mexican leader staying in Oregon, or somewhere else.
explanation.definitionFit: Geronimo was the Apache leader born in what is now Mexico and New Mexico.

clue.text: A call for assistance installing finest building material

indicators.note: installing says the distress call has the finest word put inside it

parts.note: SOS is the distress signal
best means finest

explanation.surface: A call for help over installing the finest building material.
explanation.definitionFit: Asbestos is a fibrous mineral once widely used in building for fireproofing and insulation.

clue.text: Man on board British ship at sea hiding nothing

indicators.note: hiding says the jumbled ship letters conceal the nothing letter
at sea means confused, so the letters of ship are jumbled

parts.note: O is the round figure zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A man on board a British ship at sea, hiding nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man on board' suggests a sailor, but it is a chess piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Chess pieces are often called men, and this one moves diagonally across the board.

clue.text: Arcane splinter group holding on

indicators.note: holding says the group word encloses the on letters

parts.note: a sect is a group that has split from a larger body
re means on or concerning

explanation.surface: A mysterious breakaway faction that keeps going.
explanation.definitionFit: Arcane means known only to a few, so hidden from others.

clue.text: Herb's something with great healing power reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly says the word is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: the saying goes that time is a great healer

explanation.surface: A herb is said to have great powers of healing.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is followed by 's as a link, meaning is.
explanation.definitionFit: Thyme is an aromatic garden plant used in cooking.

clue.text: Line adding novel contribution to mathematical work

indicators.note: adding says the novel follows on after the line letter

parts.note: Emma is a novel by Jane Austen

explanation.surface: A line added to a novel contribution to some mathematics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like an adjective meaning new, but it is a book.
explanation.definitionFit: A lemma is a subsidiary proposition proved as a step toward a larger theorem.
